recommendation: Keep the empty no-change audit commit. Revisit only if future publisher/template changes remove the post-content 'see the extensions' link or equivalent Extensions navigation from concrete resource pages.
issue_request: FHIR-20637 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested the option-2 layout from the linked Zulip discussion: add a link to standard extensions below resource content views rather than leaving the page unchanged or embedding an extension table.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by git commit 118fa79d000735ef4e115260ea6de72ebac5d728, which changed tools/templates/template-abstract.html, tools/templates/template-intf.html, and tools/templates/template.html under the FHIR build templates.
additional_context: The linked Zulip thread records option 2 as a lightweight link below the content view and includes feedback that full extension tables could be too long and too prominent. Later template commits adjusted tabs, R5 diff links, and extension-search registry links without removing the concrete resource extension link; current CI pages for Patient and Observation still show Extensions navigation and an Additional definitions line with 'see the extensions'. Confluence searches found no conflicting decision record.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The build-scope resource template still contains the [%ext-link%] placeholder in Additional definitions, the search templates retain extension-search placeholders, and rendered CI pages show the requested extension links below resource content.

related_jiras.note: Later template/search-page work adjusted extension-search registry links but did not change the FHIR-20637 resource-content extension visibility decision.
